name: variable-weight-text
title: Variable Weight Text
description: Text whose letters get bolder as the cursor gets closer, using the wght axis of a variable font. Optional wave that breathes when idle.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it once as a whole.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance in pixels from the cursor within which letters get bolder.

props.name: min
props.description: Weight at rest and outside the radius.

props.name: max
props.description: Weight of the letter right under the cursor.

props.name: wave
props.description: When the cursor is away, a weight wave runs through the letters. It stops off screen.

a11y: Screen readers read the whole text once from a visually hidden copy; the letter spans are aria-hidden.
The effect is decorative and needs no interaction; the text stays readable at every weight.
With reduced motion, the letters stay at the min weight and the wave does not run.

ai.whenToUse: Large display words in a hero or footer wordmark that should react to the cursor.
rules: Needs a variable font with a wght axis; with a static font the weight jumps between the available weights
Use large sizes, text-5xl and up, so the change is visible
Keep the text short, one to three words

id.description: Teks yang hurufnya makin tebal saat kursor makin dekat, memakai sumbu wght font variabel. Ada gelombang opsional yang bernapas saat diam.

props.text: Teksnya. Screen reader membacanya sekali secara utuh.
props.radius: Jarak dalam piksel dari kursor tempat huruf menebal.
props.min: Berat saat diam dan di luar radius.
props.max: Berat huruf tepat di bawah kursor.
props.wave: Saat kursor jauh, gelombang berat berjalan melewati huruf. Berhenti saat di luar layar.

a11y: Screen reader membaca teks utuh sekali dari salinan tersembunyi; span huruf memakai aria-hidden.
Efeknya dekoratif dan tidak butuh interaksi; teks tetap terbaca di setiap berat.
Dengan reduced motion, huruf tetap di berat min dan gelombang tidak berjalan.

ai.whenToUse: Kata display besar di hero atau wordmark footer yang bereaksi terhadap kursor.
rules: Butuh font variabel dengan sumbu wght; dengan font statis, berat melompat di antara berat yang tersedia
Pakai ukuran besar, text-5xl ke atas, agar perubahannya terlihat
Pakai teks pendek, satu sampai tiga kata
